meta.name: readout
meta.description: Prepare a sponsor update separating promised outcomes, measured results and customer acceptance. Use for progress readouts or defending a delivery claim.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写一份分清承诺、实测与验收的进度汇报,让赞助方一眼看懂交付情况。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要定期向赞助方或高层汇报进度并解释交付结果。
copy.tagline_en: Write a progress update that separates promises, measured results and sign-off.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly brief sponsors or executives on project progress and delivery.

howto.what: Claude 会生成给发起人(sponsor)的进度汇报,把承诺的结果、实测结果与客户验收分开列出,并保留未知项,区分实现、验证、部署和验收。用于进度汇报,或为交付主张做说明。
howto.when: 当你需要做进度汇报(readout),或需要为一项交付主张辩护时接管。若由 @fde 调用,会复用其当前的净化数据包和范围,不重跑已答过的设置与提问。

say.text: 帮我准备一份给发起人的进度汇报,分开写承诺结果、实测结果和客户验收
say.note: 产出一份分层汇报草稿

say.text: 客户质疑我们的交付成果,按承诺、实测、验收三层帮我说明
这份更新里哪些是已验证、哪些只是已部署?帮我标清楚
say.note: 保留未知项并区分阶段

howto.what_en: Claude prepares a sponsor update that keeps promised outcomes, measured results, and customer acceptance separate, preserving unknowns and distinguishing implementation, verification, deployment and acceptance. Use it for progress readouts or to defend a delivery claim.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need a progress readout or must defend a delivery claim. If invoked by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or questions.

say_en.text: Draft a sponsor update separating promised, measured, and acceptance items.
Customer disputes our delivery claim — separate promised, measured, accepted.
Which items are verified vs merely deployed? Label them in this update.
